name: ZX_EXEMPTIONS_STG
description: This table stores tax exemption details that need to be imported into tax exemptions table.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch name to identify the set of records to be processed.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the party type for party tax profile.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to identify party type of the exemption.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of this exemption. Possible values are DISCOUNT and SPECIAL_RATE.This is the method of calculating the exemption percentage.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates approval status for this exemption.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Stores tax code for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code for this exemption

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Exemption certificate number. This is the certificate number that applies to this exemption and considered during tax calculation, if entered on the transaction line.

columns.name: EXEMPT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the reason for this exemption. This is the exempt reason that applies to this exemption and considered during tax calculation, if entered on the transaction line.

columns.name: ISSUING_TAX_AUTHORITY_NAME
columns.description: The tax authority that has issued the exemption certificate for this exemption.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date. This date should be within the date range of the entities (tax regime, tax, tax status, tax rate, and tax jurisdiction) related to this tax exemption.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date. This date should be within the date range of the entities (tax regime, tax, tax status, tax rate, and tax jurisdiction) related to this tax exemption.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Configuration owner of this tax.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Item number to identify the Item

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_NAME
columns.description: Name of the inventory organization for the item. This is applicable for product-specific exemption.

columns.name: RATE_MODIFIER
columns.description: Percentage of the original tax rate that is exempt if exemption type is discount. Percentage of tax rate if exemption type is special / surcharge.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction for the exemption.

columns.name: APPLY_TO_LOWER_LEVELS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N Indicates if this exemption is applicable to taxes at lower levels. This indicates that this exemption applies to all taxes that use this tax as the tax exemptions source.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description:
Gives the validation status of the record being processed:
NULL - only these records will be picked up for processing by program
0  - record picked up by concurrent program for validation
1  -all id???s validated
2  - successful record
3 - error record

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
